label: organization based or located in
definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
scope_notes: Based-in, headquarters-in and geographic company/firm descriptions dominate, preserving the prior organizational-location scope. Geographic noun modifiers qualify for firms; subject-matter or industry modifiers and personal/event locations alone do not.

facts.reason: Petroleum Finance Company is repeatedly described as a Washington firm, group and company, giving institutional geographic location.
Microsoft is explicitly based in Redmond and has headquarters and campus there.
Internet modifies Forrester Research as its industry or research subject, with internet traffic and usage paths; Internet is not a geographic institutional location.
I.B.M. is explicitly based and headquartered in Armonk; additional say and working paths do not negate the location evidence.
MCI is explicitly based in Washington and its headquarters are situated there; board-meeting evidence is additional.
